description: This file defines an exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedFunctionError' within the Twig Sandbox security framework, used when an unauthorized function is invoked in a template.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedFunctionError
classes.description: An exception class thrown when a not allowed function is used in a Twig template, extending SecurityError and capturing the name of the disallowed function.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message and the name of the disallowed function.

methods.name: getFunctionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the disallowed function that caused the exception.
